reasons.action: The brief explicitly requests that the car move through a snowy street and not keep the source static pose, so the new action is request-governed.
reasons.medium: The accepted medium decision pins the rendering medium to 1990s cel animation, so medium is request-governed.
reasons.wardrobe: No clothing or accessory change is requested; the observed carbon fibre body is retained as reference identity rather than a wardrobe override.
reasons.lighting: No explicit instruction about the light source, direction, or visible quality is given; snowy street and showroom-background replacement do not authorize replacing reference lighting.
reasons.framing: No actual camera composition, shot scale, viewpoint, or movement is requested; movement through the street is action, and 16:9 canvas ratio is not framing direction.
reasons.palette: No explicit color grade, saturation, contrast, or tonal treatment is requested; the cel-animation medium change and snowy setting do not by themselves govern palette.
